items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk, playful and curious, with natural emphasis on the country names and a short comic pause before each punchline. Chars voices a funny cartoon United Kingdom, crying dramatically. The countdown builds: number one is the biggest, most excited reveal. The last line trails off so it can loop back into the first line.
lines: I bet a hundred dollars you didn't know there are some countries that look completely different, but are almost exactly the same size!
Let's start with number five: Nepal and Bangladesh.
They are only twenty-two kilometres apart, but one touches the sky with Mount Everest, while the other touches the ocean with its rivers!
Number four is Guinea and the United Kingdom.
You won't believe it. Once the biggest empire in the world, it now has an area as small as Guinea.
Number three is Chile and Zambia.
If you pull Zambia like chewing gum, then you would get another Chile of the same size.
Number two is Italy and the Philippines.
One looks like a boot, while the other looks like a sitting man.
But put them together, and they form a complete human body.
[building excitement, big reveal] And number one... is Malaysia and Vietnam!
Both are in Southeast Asia, have long coastlines, and are almost the same size.
[warm, a little teasing] I think they were made for each other.
[cheeky, quick, trailing off] Want to go double or nothing? Because...
